title: Stalk criterion for strict-local cohomology exchange
statement: For a qcqs morphism g : T ⟶ S, a sheaf F on T and degree q, the geometric stalk of the degree-q derived exchange at x is an isomorphism if and only if the induced pullback map on the cohomology of the corresponding strict henselization base-change square is bijective, for every compatible strict-local ring map a.

proof.text: Equip the two strict henselization rings with their canonical strictly henselian local structures. The evaluation equality makes a local ring homomorphism, and the structural equality gives the induced pullback square. Apply the canonical strict-henselization stalk exchange comparison and the strict-local total cohomology exchange comparison. The resulting additive equivalences conjugate the stalk map to the displayed cohomology pullback, so bijectivity is equivalent.
